observations: Photo 0 shows a console in a plastic bag/cover inside a shop window; only the front grille area is partially visible.
Photo 1 shows the front grille area of a console in plastic; no clear view of model label, ports, controller, or disc drive (if any).
No readable brand/model text is visible on the console in either photo; no accessories/receipt are shown.

claims.claim: Microsoft Xbox One S All-Digital Edition Console (Disc-free ...)
claims.evidence: Photos only show the front grille through plastic; no readable model/label or disc-free confirmation.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working.
claims.evidence: No internal/serial/temperature evidence; no port test shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No pads/accessories or receipt are shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Item may not be Xbox One S All-Digital (could be another Xbox model or even a different console), since the photos don’t show a readable model/label.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the console model/serial label (sticker) and the back ports (USB/HDMI/Ethernet) with the plastic removed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic, unverified Xbox console with unknown condition (worst case vs the claimed model).

risks.risk: All ports working is not demonstrated; some ports (HDMI/USB/Ethernet) may be faulty.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the console powered on and a live test: HDMI display + at least one USB device + Ethernet link (or controller charging/connection).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed fully functional (worst case).

risks.risk: “Never opened or repaired” and “no overheating” can’t be verified remotely; thermal issues may exist.
risks.proof: Ask for a video after 15–20 minutes of gameplay/loading showing stable operation (no shutdown) and optionally an IR/temperature check screenshot if they can.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing repair/with unknown thermal health (worst case).

risks.risk: Accessories/receipt may be missing or not original.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the included pads/accessories laid out and a clear photo of the UK receipt (with sensitive details covered).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no confirmed original pads/receipt).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the console’s model/serial label (sticker) with the plastic removed.
Back ports photo (HDMI/USB/Ethernet) and a short power-on video showing it boots.
Video proof of port functionality (HDMI to TV + USB device/controller connection).
Photos of included pads/accessories and a clear UK receipt photo (details can be masked).
response.reason: The photos do not show enough identifying details (model label/ports) to confirm it’s an Xbox One S All-Digital, and the key claims (ports working, no overheating, included items) are not evidenced.
